businesses.business: Welding, cutting and gas control equipment

offering_description.value: ESAB makes welding consumables, welding and cutting equipment, and automated fabrication systems for manufacturers, metal fabricators and contractors. It supplies gas control equipment to industrial users and healthcare providers and offers software for managing welding operations.

primary_products.value: welding consumables; welding and cutting machines; automated welding systems; industrial and medical gas control equipment; welding management software

primary_services.value: equipment installation and commissioning; maintenance and repair; operator training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Metal fabrication shops, manufacturers, contractors, industrial gas suppliers and healthcare facilities; B2C: Independent welders and hobbyists buying portable equipment and supplies

end_markets.value: metal fabrication; construction and infrastructure; energy and process industries; transportation manufacturing; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: Welding consumables, welding and cutting equipment, automated systems and gas control equipment; service fees: Equipment maintenance, repair and training; subscription: Cloud software for monitoring welding equipment and production

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns metals, electronics and other purchased inputs into consumables and equipment for fabricators and healthcare providers; component supplier: Supplies gas regulators, valves and related components to gas system builders and equipment makers; software / platform: Uses welding machine and production data to help fabrication shops monitor equipment and manage work; service provider: Installs, commissions and maintains fabrication equipment for industrial customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Welding consumables and machinery, cutting, fabrication automation and software, and industrial and medical gas control

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Welding supply houses, industrial equipment dealers and medical gas equipment distributors; direct sales: Sales teams serving large manufacturers, fabricators and buyers of engineered systems

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Environmental and workplace safety rules apply to manufacturing, with FDA requirements for certain medical gas devices.

notes: The scope of separately billed services and the subscription terms for welding software are uncertain.
